keywords.title: Search keywords
keywords.description: Keywords to search for (one search per keyword, results merged and deduplicated). Example: climate, youth education, rural health.

oppStatuses.title: Opportunity statuses
oppStatuses.description: posted = open now; forecasted = announced but not yet open (early intel).

agencyCodes.title: Agency codes (optional)
agencyCodes.description: Restrict to agencies, e.g. NSF, HHS, USDA, DOC, ED. Empty = all agencies.

fundingCategories.title: Funding category codes (optional)
fundingCategories.description: grants.gov funding activity category codes, e.g. ED (Education), ENV (Environment), HL (Health), ST (Science).

eligibilityCodes.title: Eligibility codes (optional)
eligibilityCodes.description: grants.gov applicant eligibility codes, e.g. 12 (nonprofits w/ 501c3), 00 (state governments), 20 (private institutions of higher education), 22 (for-profits), 25 (others).

includeDetails.title: Fetch full details per opportunity
includeDetails.description: Adds award ceiling/floor, estimated funding, applicant types, description, and agency contact email to each row (one extra request per opportunity).

maxOpportunities.title: Max opportunities per run
maxOpportunities.description: Cap on grant rows returned. Controls total cost.

dedupe.title: Skip opportunities seen in previous runs
dedupe.description: Remember returned opportunity IDs across runs and skip them. Turn on for scheduled new-grant alerts.
